name: @barqel/barq-app
description: The Barq application framework: batteries-included kernel, base classes, generators and testing helpers for building apps with Barq + Bun

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --external @barqel/barq --external @barqel/barq-cli --external @barqel/barq-compress --external @barqel/barq-cron --external @barqel/barq-env --external @barqel/barq-events --external @barqel/barq-helmet --external @barqel/barq-i18n --external @barqel/barq-idempotency --external @barqel/barq-logger --external @barqel/barq-openapi --external @barqel/barq-rate-limit --external @barqel/barq-static --external reflect-metadata --external tsyringe --external zod --target=node --format=esm --sourcemap=external --outdir dist && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build

author: Barq Contributors
